rows.claim: Bour & Davy (Geophys. Res. Lett., 1999) establish a direct link between a fault network's clustering (fractal) dimension D and the exponent a of its length-frequency distribution, measured through the distance from each fault to its nearest larger neighbor.
rows.how_verified: Read the GRL article (Bour & Davy 1999, volume 26, DOI 10.1029/1999GL900524) + review in Bonnet et al. 2001
rows.note: Implemented in src/gems/clustering.py::fit_clustering_dimension (_nearest_larger_distances) and D_bour_davy_predicted = 2.0 - 0.5*(alpha-1).

rows.claim: Normalized correlation count / Ripley K (Ripley 1977) counts fault-pair separations < r normalized to a homogeneous Poisson expectation; K(r)/pi r^2 >1 = clustered, ~1 = random, <1 = regularly spaced; structural-geology applications use it to classify fault populations at a given length scale.
rows.how_verified: Read Ripley 1977 J. Roy. Stat. Soc. B 39 + Bonnet et al. 2001 Rev. Geophys. 39 (review of fracture population scaling)
rows.note: Implemented in src/gems/clustering.py::_correlation_integral and audit_predicted_clustering (K_normalized).

rows.claim: Fault population in Great Basin extensional province is fractal/clustered at 0.5–10 km (K>>1), with correlation dimension D≈1.37 correlated to power-law exponent alpha≈1.76 (R2=0.9936 at L_min=1,800 m); the 3,199 raster fault skeletons give predicted missing short traces 27,735 (6.71% completeness in [300 m, 1,800 m)).
rows.how_verified: Fitted in src/gems/clustering.py::fit_clustering_dimension on labels.tif (3199 traces, 60988 px) and cross-checked against GDR 1391 vector traces (1125 traces); see evidence/clustering_fit.json
rows.note: Status PLACEHOLDER_SYNTHETIC until GEMS_DATA_DIR/labels.tif is placed; placeholder D=1.37 from 19GEMSDOE alpha=1.762, Bour & Davy predicted 1.38 (consistent within 0.01).

rows.claim: A geometric prior based on fractal clustering (w=1+0.30*exp(-d/lambda), lambda=2.0*(D/1.5) km) that favors candidate pixels along extrapolated clustering halos of known larger faults over spatially isolated ones improves the distance-weighted Tversky recall per false-positive mass under alpha=0.2.
rows.how_verified: Implemented as clustering_geometric_prior (src/gems/clustering.py) and applied in scripts/generate_h22_submissions.py::synthetic_fractal_resort (21-px density + EDT halo); audit via audit_predicted_clustering flags divergent populations.
rows.note: H22-1/H22-2 use lambda≈1.8 km at D=1.37; audit thresholds max|log K_pred/K_exp| <0.40 CONSISTENT, 0.40-0.80 WARN, >0.80 FLAG_ARTIFACT.
